note: Generated gore layers for the graphic-fatality presentation. Played only through goreSfx() (rate-capped, gated on the Graphic Fatalities toggle). Cue kinds and volumes are defined in engine/gore.mjs GORE_SFX.

gore-arterial.beat: systolic spurt hiss on heartbeat peaks

gore-squelch.beat: wet tissue tear on the killing blow

gore-bone.beat: bone report on the killing blow

gore-body-drop.beat: the collapse settling, once per fatality
